description: Submit a quote lead through the existing public quote API. Requires consent=true and a contact block with name and email. consent is explicit permission to store that contact with the calculated quote. This tool does not issue a consent receipt and does not change pricing, financing, or warranty. Confirm storage only from the returned lead_captured flag. Annotations are hints, not authorization.

customer_has_propeller.description: True: reuse, subject to fit checks. False: include allowance. Omitted: reuse for same-HP Mercury trade, otherwise allowance. Standard propeller included below 25 HP.

horsepower.description: Required unless model infers a single HP.

name: submit_quote_lead
